descriptor.scene: A BUSTLING MID-2010s MEDIA OFFICE IN FULL SWING, and TWO MEN cross it together: DAVID KOBROSKY, college-young in his navy polo, carries a cardboard box stacked with a laptop and rolled posters, and beside him strides GARY VEE, his boss, stocky and electric in a dark crew-neck tee, mid-sentence, one arm flung toward the doorway he is steering David through. DAVID'S EYES ARE ON GARY VEE and GARY VEE'S EYES ARE ON DAVID: the boss is talking, the kid is grinning and keeping up. Around them the office churns: desks jammed with monitors kept dark and papers kept bright, a wall calendar dense with marker scrawl, two staffers in motion carrying tripods and garment bags, coffee cups everywhere. The energy is loud, warm, and fast. Lower-right: floor with a strip of gaffer tape, calm.
descriptor._caption: Before building his own thing he was Gary Vee's first crypto hire, sent to explore the strangest new corner of the internet. The job taught him how crowds gather online, and how they scatter. He kept the lesson.
descriptor.anonymous: Two background staffers in motion, visibly distinct from both named men: a woman with a red ponytail in a dark green tee, and a tall thin man with blond curls in a mustard sweater. Nobody else has short dark hair or a stubble beard; nobody wears navy or any blue shirt.
negatives: a second man resembling Gary Vee
any background figure with short dark hair and stubble
